name: John S. Pringle

death.place: 25 East Shawnee Avenue, Plymouth, Luzerne Co.

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives John's birth as July 1860 and his marriage to Regina Styer (Stiers) in 1887, from a county marriage record. He was in Plymouth Twp in 1900 and Plymouth Ward 9 in 1910. He died on 22 Dec 1933 at 25 East Shawnee Avenue, Plymouth, and was buried at Forty Fort (S1).

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, John S. Pringle (KG4S-X75), with attached index entries
